create_simplicial_embedding: create a SimplicialEmbedding module with L chunks and an optional temperature parameter
run_simplicial_forward: run the SimplicialEmbedding forward pass to softmax-normalize input tensor chunks
build_simplicial_from_config: build a SimplicialEmbedding instance from a SimplicialEmbeddingConfig dataclass
create_simplicial_wrapper: create a SimplicialWrapper that applies simplicial embeddings on top of a pretrained vision module
review_empty_wrapper: review the Empty_wrapper pass-through module that delegates to a receiver module
